title: GrepSignal immutable record-version snapshot
description: Immutable public projection captured when a GrepSignal record reached one record version. Derived cross-record context is frozen as of snapshot_sequence and may differ from the later current projection without changing this snapshot.

snapshot_sequence.description: Global public change sequence when this record version was captured. Legacy version 0 snapshots use sequence 0.

snapshot_event_id.description: Accepted public event that created this record version; null for the imported legacy snapshot.

snapshot_recorded_at.description: Journal/migration capture time for this immutable snapshot, not necessarily the event or source publication time.

event_sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the accepted event when this version came from a journal event.

cite_as.description: Human-readable stable citation label for this record version.

record.description: The public record projection frozen at snapshot_sequence.
